Glance 2026.07.25 improves document navigation and long-running preview resource usage.

## Highlights

- Pan enlarged PDF and Office document previews with the left mouse button.
- Reduce accumulated WebView2 processes by sharing preview infrastructure and closing inactive controls.
- Select the default text preview font from common fonts installed on Windows.
